method: inventory of requirements.txt/pyproject.toml surfaces (worktrees excluded); disposition assigned per blueprint native-first intent and codex Python-bounded roles (governance semantics, adjudication, codex tooling, training, bounded adapters)

dispositions.note: mechanical process/resource sampling; worker-plane governor already proves the metric set is narrow (cpu/rss/child enumeration)
governed information-layer Postgres adapter; codex permits bounded adapters until native parity
external semantic-candidate adapter; replaceable by a thin native HTTP client when G50/RAG migration lands
channel transport is mechanical I/O; migrates with information-channel-gateway -> migrate-csharp
bridge needed only while bounded Python adapters coexist with native libs; removable at full native cutover
HTML normalization is mechanical; G50/RAG migration path
external ffmpeg binary adapter; bounded media tooling
resident numerics migrate to native core; Python numpy only survives inside the training window
Python reranker path; G50 covers the native reranker/CUDA load point
codex permits Python for training; inference paths must not consume torch — enforced by production .pyd route (G29)
segmentation is mechanical; native tokenizer supersedes
HF tokenizers only needed until native tokenizer parity (X-package)
GPU kernels already exist natively (matmul_fp8/bf16); triton extra only relevant during parity window
